name: BETA-SIXDOUZE
source:
Bathed in the light of the moon, a giant rose blooms in full glory. It hangs darkly in the night sky, suspended in space some 380,000 km from Earth. With its true name and nature unknowable, we humans have taken to calling it “Consuelo.”

The protagonist, Hakone Yousuke, is a STX Forces' combat pilot. One day, he meets a strange girl named Hanako and becomes her partner as an elite pilot. They board the Counter Flower-from-Other-Star Maneuverable Suit, codenamed "Battleship," and confront Consuelo, humanity's threat. Mentally, Hanako is a child. She is very pure and does not grasp honeyed words or subtleties. Yousuke gets close to her and so faces his "principle of action," which was vague before.

[b]Who is Hanako?.. Is she an enemy of humanity? Or is she an ally?
Will humanity be able to oppose the menacing invasion?[/b]

[i]This is an adventure, shining in the stars, for adults, who once were boys and girls.
This is a tale about humen who discover precious things, that do not show in one's eyes.[/i]

[Translated from the [url=https://www.liar.co.jp/beta-sixdouze/story.html]official site[/url]]
translation:
沐浴着月光，一朵巨大的蔷薇绚烂盛放。它幽幽地悬于夜空，漂浮在距离地球约38万千米的宇宙之中。无人知晓它真正的名字与本质，人类便将其称为“康斯薇洛”。

主人公箱根羊介，是隶属于STX军的战斗驾驶员。某一天，他遇见了名为花子的神秘少女，并以精英驾驶员的身份，与她结为搭档。两人登上星外除花机动装，通称“战斗羊”，迎战威胁人类的康斯薇洛。花子的精神年龄如同孩子，纯真无垢，不懂甜言蜜语与言外之意。随着与花子逐渐交心，羊介也开始直面自己此前一直模糊不清的“行动原理”。

[b]花子究竟是什么人……是人类的敌人，还是同伴？
人类能否抵抗这场来势汹汹的侵略？[/b]

[i]这是一段献给曾经年少的大人们，在星空中闪耀的冒险。
也是一个关于人们发现那些目不可见、却弥足珍贵之物的故事。[/i]

[译自[url=https://www.liar.co.jp/beta-sixdouze/story.html]官方网站[/url]]
